# Your Icon on the Map

Version 1.19.1 lets the strike markers on the map show an icon of your choice instead of the lightning bolt.

## Markers

- **A marker style with your own icon.** _[#124]_ The markers could only be the standard lightning bolt, a crosshair, a plus or a dot. The new `custom` style keeps the standard filled marker and draws the icon set in `map_marker_icon` on it, `mdi:flash` unless you choose another. Any icon Home Assistant can show works, custom icon sets included. In the editor the icon picker appears once the custom style is selected.

```yaml
map_marker_style: custom
map_marker_icon: mdi:weather-lightning
```

Thanks to @Deach01 for the idea.
